purpose: Correct the explicit scan-to-TSDF transform in the full-bag and bounded E2E examples. Synthetic coordinate correctness only; no measured calibration or real accuracy qualification.

fixed_contract.notation: A_T_B maps points from B into A. ScanOdometry stores current_front_T_first_front. Calibration paths provide body_T_sensor. The volume gauge is the first body frame (first front frame for the uncalibrated bounded smoke).
fixed_contract.other_sensor: volume_T_current_sensor = body_T_front * inverse(current_front_T_first_front) * inverse(body_T_front) * body_T_sensor. Both sensors share one rigid body motion; inverse-only rear transport is insufficient under rotation and lever arms.
fixed_contract.failure: Reject non-finite inputs, inverses and composed results before TSDF insertion. Existing proper-rigid calibration/matcher assumptions remain. No new normalization policy or frame/clock evidence is invented.
fixed_contract.admission: Keep source SHA/path/size, registered clock/frame readiness, actual frame IDs, timestamp synchronization, bounded IO and storage admission unchanged. Rear uses the existing matched front timestamp without interpolation; the sync bound is not simultaneous-motion proof.
fixed_contract.execution: One private shared example helper, constant work per scan, no public API/core/math change, device copies, threads or dependencies. Preserve input transforms, record timestamps, frames and provenance.

verification: Commit protocol first, then extract the unchanged old consumer algebra into the shared helper and commit independent physical-coordinate tests. Retain a failing baseline before fixing production math. Hand-defined signed-axis rotations and inverse observation equations recover static points from translating/rotating front and rear sensors, including nonidentity noncommuting extrinsics, first pose and inverse-only lever-arm counterexample. Check finite errors, existing clock/frame/source/resource gates, both examples, ROS2 crate, mapping bridge, Clippy and formatting. Execute both examples on Linux/Windows/macOS CI.

resources.preservation: Hash-protect existing scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, pinned reference sources and completed room audit outputs. Reuse the existing cache; no frozen binary/wheel rebuild, old evidence deletion or real-motion fit. Retain failed attempts.

remaining_80_percent: Native complete room accuracy and genuinely unobserved motion qualification; both qualifying raw Linux hardware classes; matching canonical measured clock uncertainty and physical frame accuracy; full canonical mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance. Coordinate fixtures do not satisfy these requirements.
